outputs.explanation: Panel A shows photographic ex vivo lung images (bright-field and ICG fluorescence), not a plot of averaged data, so this check does not apply.
Panel B is a bar chart of mean ICG fluorescence intensity ± SD, and the individual data points for each mouse (blue and red dots) are overlaid on the bars.

Panel C includes micrographs (H&E, ICG, RNAscope) and spatial heatmap-style plots showing Log2 expression of Cd68 and Spp1 across tissue spots; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel D contains GSEA enrichment line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points on running-sum line plots is not meaningful.

Panel E is a bar chart showing Log2 fold-change values (an aggregate/summary statistic) for a set of genes from DEG analysis, but no individual underlying data points (e.g., per-spot or per-cell expression values) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel F shows fluorescence and IHC micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data, so this check does not apply.
